regions.merged_text: I hope you are well and that things are coming favorably for you. I am sure my failure to acknowledge your appreciated favor of December 6th last, must have been deeply disapointing. Please pardon! I can hardly explain further than that, wish- ing to thank you personaly for such a favor, I put your brief letter aside and, some how or other it was simply "snowd under." However, I am sure God has blessed you just the same, and you have been included in our prayers as noted at the time. Besides this, I am going to offer my first - next - "Free Mass" for your intentions, your guidance, and welfare. Incidently we have the privilege of two such "free-Masse " each month.

regions.merged_text: God bless you Miss Belain, you and yours:

regions.merged_text: Thanking you a million for your kindness and hoping such failure on my part may not occur in the future, I beg to remain, at your service, Sincerely yours in Christ,
